metadata.title: IELTS Practice
metadata.description: Learn IELTS vocabulary with spaced repetition, native audio and images.

landing.heroTitle: Remember every IELTS word you learn
landing.heroSubtitle: Flashcards with real pronunciation, a picture for every word and reviews timed to the moment you are about to forget.
landing.featuresTitle: Built for the way memory works
landing.featureSrsBody: The same scheduling approach as Anki (FSRS) shows each word again just before you would forget it.
landing.featureAudioBody: British and American pronunciation for the word and every example sentence.
landing.featureImageBody: A picture next to each meaning makes new words easier to recall.
landing.featureCardsBody: Paste a list of words and get word forms, Vietnamese meanings, collocations and examples.
landing.closingTitle: Ten minutes a day is enough
landing.closingBody: Sign in with Google and start with the words you need for your target band.
landing.footer: Made for IELTS learners in Vietnam and everywhere else.

auth.title: Welcome back
auth.subtitle: Sign in to keep your decks and review progress on every device.
auth.privacy: We only use your name, email and profile photo from Google.
auth.sideTitle: Your vocabulary, one day at a time
auth.sideBody: Short daily reviews, audio and images for every word.

dashboard.subtitle: Here is your study plan for today.
dashboard.emptyBody: Create a deck and add the words you want to learn. Your daily reviews will appear here.

placeholder.decksBody: Your decks and their daily review counts will appear here.
placeholder.collectionsBody: Curated IELTS word lists. Pick how many words to learn each day.
placeholder.addWordsBody: Paste one or more words and get complete cards with audio and images.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Your profile and how you study.
settings.profileBody: Used across the app and to calculate your study day.
settings.timezoneHelp: Your daily reviews reset at the start of your study day in this time zone.
settings.dayStartHourHelp: Like Anki, a study day starts at 4:00 by default so late-night sessions count for the same day.
settings.newCardsPerDayHelp: Each new card adds roughly 8 to 10 reviews per day after a few weeks.
settings.desiredRetentionHelp: How often you want to remember a card when it comes back. Higher means more reviews.
settings.showImageOnFront: Show the image on the front of the card
settings.advancedBody: Anki-style scheduling options. The defaults work well for most learners.
settings.learningStepsHelp: How soon new cards come back on the first day, e.g. “1m 10m”.
settings.relearningStepsHelp: How soon a forgotten card comes back, e.g. “10m”.
